content_md:
[Peptide broadside](https://birb.report/on-taking-peptides), from Chairman Birb.

I still have not taken any peptides because I am poor these days, [but I'd like to](https://www.frontstageexit.com/p/what-we-talk-about-when-we-talk-about). I'd like to get on testosterone (not really a peptide) and maybe oxytocin. I'd like to try NAD+. Fundamentally, though, the idea that we'd stand in the way of people experimenting on their own dime really infuriates me.

Also just approve reta for goodness sake. A bajillion people are using it off the book and it's going great.

It is crazy that such a gigantic dent has been made in the U.S.'s biggest health problem, obesity, and we're pussyfooting about widespread adoption.
